The '''Spider Dream Mystery''' is an [[Easter Eggs & Secrets in Redemption 2|Easter egg]] and unsolved mystery in ''[[Red Dead Redemption 2]]'' and ''[[Red Dead Online]]''. === Part 1: === The hunt begins at [[Butcher Creek]], where the Butcher Creek pentagram can be found glowing between 4-5am. Inspecting the nearby outhouses, players will find tally marks etched inside them that, when connected in order, form a pentagram shape. The fourth outhouse has extra symbols on it including an "LJ", "SM", and a symbol depicting [[Fort Brennand]]. The outhouse in Fort Brennand has six tally marks and on one of the towers inside Fort Brennand, there are seven tally marks on the entrance. Inside that tower are three more symbols depicting a telephone pole, a factory, and an oil puddle. File:Butcher Creek Pentagram.PNG|The Infamous Butcher Creek Pentagram serves as the starting point to the Spider Dream Mystery File:ButcherCreekOuthouses.PNG|The outhouses in Butcher Creek have tally mark numbers that form a pentagram when connected in order File:FortandLetters.PNG|On the 4th outhouse is a symbol depicting Fort Brennand, and the letters "LJ" and "SM" File:FortBren.PNG|The tally marks as well as the telephone pole, factory, and oil puddle symbols found inside Fort Brennand === Part 2: === The symbols on Fort Brennand direct the player to a telephone pole near [[Cornwall Kerosene & Tar]], which features a spider carving on it. Atop this pole is a web with a feather on it that can '''only''' be seen at a very specific time of day. The spider engraving is meant to show the direction of 7 other webs that follow this same pattern. These webs will usually show up during the night at times like 2-3am, 3-4am, etc. and will not appear if it is not this specific time. At the center of the spider is another set of webs that show up between 1-2am and do not have feathers. These webs line up to form an "N" and a telephone pole. File:SpiderEngraving.PNG|This is the spider engraving on the telephone pole next to Cornwall Kerosene & Tar File:SpiderWebLocations.png|The spider engraving shows the location of the other webs and the eye directs the player towards more poles. File:SpiderWebPole.png|This web near Saint Denis can '''only''' appear at 3-4am, while other webs are locked to different times File:CenterWeb.PNG|The model for the center webs, lined up to reveal the N and telephone pole === Part 3: === Traveling directly north of the center webs will lead to a telephone pole that can be shot into to reveal an inscription. The inscription reads "W ✞✞✞✞✞". These 'crosses' are actually telephone poles, and the W stands for 'West'. Travel 5 poles west of the pole to find yet another pole the player can shoot many times to find another inscription, which reads "NW" and has a symbol that looks like a guitar. File:TelephonePoles.png|Shooting this telephone pole reveals an inscription pointing the player towards the guitar pole File:GuitarPole.png|The guitar pole revealed after being shot into many times File:GuitarPoleLocation.PNG|Northwest of the guitar pole may lead to Fort Wallace, where two guitars can be found. === Part 4: A web of ideas === ==== '''''Everything in this section is speculative. While some references may be pretty cut and dry, do not take anything included here as evidential truths.''''' ====
Everything past the guitar symbol is the subject of heavy debate. Some believe that it isn't a guitar at all, and is instead a shape in the rocks or the map itself that the game wants you to travel northwest of. Others have focused their attention on Fort Wallace, which has two guitars inside of it pointing in different directions. Some also believe that the guitar may even be a red herring, and that shooting the feathers on the webs under certain conditions or in a certain pattern may activate a hidden trigger. ====== The Directional Theory ====== Some have taken to following the heading of the guitars directly, and have ended up in locations such as [[Dodd's Bluff]], [[Vetter's Echo]], and [[Window Rock]]. Some believe that the [[Strange Statues (Cave Painting)|Strange Statues]] mural at Window Rock may have a double meaning as it depicts birds with different amounts of black and red feathers, as well as harboring many symbols that may have a deeper meaning to them. There are also two birds that spawn on top of Window Rock and the sun shining through the center could lead to something, but this has been inconclusive thus far. File:StrangeStatuesMural.PNG|The symbols on the Strange Statues mural may be more than meets the eye At Vetter's Echo, there are matches laid out on the desk forming the letters "EC" sitting right next to the [[Cigarette Cards|cigarette card]] for the Black Widow spider in a web. In the desk underneath are the letters to Annabella and a [[Cheats in Redemption 2|cheat code]] that gives the player a higher wanted level. The meaning of the matches are unknown, but there are three other sets of matches like this found around the map that depict "J + M", "S + J", and an arrow that points towards a stash. File:Ecspider.PNG|A set of matches spelling out letters next to the depiction of a spider is a peculiar sight.. but is there a deeper meaning? ====== The Native Connection ====== Some believe that the solution may be rooted in a deep understanding of Native American history and/or the game's Native storyline due to the feathers and the spider. There is a prominent Native American figure known as the [[Wikipedia:Spider Grandmother|Spider Grandmother]] who in some stories gave souls to the inhabitants of Earth shortly after their creation, and separated them into tribes while continuing to serve a cursory role in their existence, usually in the form of a spider. ====== The Birds Theory ====== In the westernmost tower of Fort Wallace is one of the guitars. On the roof above the guitar are two "w" or bird symbols that are made from the tower's geometry and shaded with the moss texture. Some believe that this may simply be a modeling error or developer initials, though the same method of hiding symbols into the geometry is used for the Butcher Creek outhouses and not seen anywhere else; so this idea is heavily up for debate. File:FortWallaceSymbols.PNG|These strange symbols above the guitar in Fort Wallace have not yet been deciphered The Strange Man channel on YouTube has pushed for the idea that the birds indicate the nearby flock of birds that lead to the [[Giant]]'s cave, and posited that there is a question mark shape that can be seen from that spot on the mountain outside of the boundaries of the map. This has led to many others seeing various symbols in the wood and rocks around the map, something that has been attributed to being a simple case of [[Wikipedia:Pareidolia|pareidolia]]. File:Questionmark1.PNG|Could this be a question mark? File:Questionmark2.PNG|..Or is it just pareidolia Others believe the symbols may actually indicate exactly ''two'' birds, and have searched [[Two Crows]] and other spots where two birds can be found but the results for this have been inconclusive.
=== Additional Notes: === * The feathers on the webs are called "spiderdream" in the files; they can be shot but will respawn and their texture names are labeled "wap_gen_feather01" There is a total of five black feathers and three red feathers in the webs found. It may be [[Red Dead Redemption 2 Cut Content|cut]] content, as northwest of the guitar pole points towards the beta location for what is believed to be either Wapiti, an army camp, or Iron Cloud. It also points in the direction of [[Fort Wallace]], [[Chez Porter]], [[Cotorra Springs]], [[Tempest Rim]], [[Bacchus Bridge]], and points directly to the very tip of [[Spider Gorge]]. Spider Gorge is particularly noteworthy as it has "spider" in the name and has a vaguely guitar-shaped section, while Fort Wallace has a guitar inside the fort. * This is similar to the [[dreamcatchers]] side mission, which interestingly does not properly disappear from the log after completion. * [[community:c:gta:Mount_Chiliad_(HD_Universe)|Mount Chiliad]] in ''[[community:c:gta:Grand_Theft_Auto_V|Grand Theft Auto V]]'' also has two webs made of cables that only spawn between 1-2am. *This Easter Egg appears to be referenced in one of the possible fortunes from the [[w:c:gta:Nazar Speaks|Nazar Speaks]] arcade machine added to ''[[w:c:gta:Grand Theft Auto Online|Grand Theft Auto Online]]'' with [[w:c:gta:GTA Online: The Diamond Casino Heist|The Diamond Casino Heist]] update in 2019. The fortune reads: "I see a web, still tangled after years of unraveling. Will you be the one? I wonder…" * All of the initial finds on this page were first discovered by goldenplaysterraria, pariah87, u/fthen2k02 and u/FL4VA-01 who kicked things off by discovering the first web. The fort symbol was discovered by u/TracySevert, its connection to the mystery and the markings on Fort Brennand were discovered by Strange Man on YouTube.
